text_block_list.text:
Today is the Japanese Derby. Meisho
Doto's rival
of the hour, Адмайр Вега,
pays her no attention.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Адмайр Вега remains focused on seizing
the
winner's star in dedication to her
departed sister.
Мэйсё Дото can only
look on in fear.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
